EXCLUSIONS, WITH REASON
  node_modules/                          (24373 files) - regenerable from package-lock.json via `npm install`; not source.
  .next/                                 (309 files)   - Next.js build output, regenerable via `npm run build`; not source.
  .git/                                  (95 files)    - version-control internals, not part of a source/handoff snapshot.
  _legacy/.next-stale-next14/            (48 files, ~22.7 MB) - stale build output from the old Next 14 tree. It is quarantined
                                                          (not deleted) inside _legacy/, but it is build output, not source,
                                                          so it need not travel. The 18 quarantined SOURCE files and
                                                          _legacy/WHY.md elsewhere in _legacy/ ARE included above, preserving
                                                          the provenance record of what was replaced and why.
  artifacts/ (screenshots/)              (4 PNGs, ~20 MB) - QA/verification evidence (rendered screenshots), not source and
                                                          not needed to read the project or run `npm install`. Excluded to
                                                          keep the tarball to source + handoff docs.
  Claude outputs/                        (6 files, ~4 MB) - session working outputs / verification evidence (a review
                                                          screenshot, an HTML review page, and PNG captures), not source.
                                                          It also duplicates OVERNIGHT_RUN_v1_00.md, which already travels
                                                          from the project root as part of the named handoff set. Excluded
                                                          for the same reason as artifacts/: evidence, not source.
  dist/ (this directory)                                - the packaging output directory itself; excluded to avoid the
                                                          tarball attempting to include itself while being written.
